text:
You walk past a bakery in Osborne Park every morning.

Day one, you keep walking. Day nine, you're in there with a pie.

Most people searching for what you sell don't book the first time.

Ads on YouTube and Facebook keep your name in front of them until they're ready.

Perth tradies, keep an eye on this one.

Local Services Ads charge per lead. You pay when someone calls or messages. Clicks cost nothing.

Google is moving them inside Google Ads. US first, accounts outside the US in 2027.

When it lands here, test it next to your search ads.

Your marketing doesn't need a funnel diagram.

Someone needs what you sell. They search. You're there. They call.

The ones who didn't call yet? Keep showing up until they do.

If your plan needs a whiteboard to explain, it's too clever.
